blockedConflict: Page changed elsewhere: reload before continuing.
blockedCorrupt: Unreadable draft: start again from the published version first.
undoImpossible: Can't undo this step: the project has changed (image deleted?).
redoImpossible: Can't redo this step: the project has changed (image deleted?).
cannotAddHere: This block can't be added here.
gridGone: This grid no longer exists: reload the editor.
pdfInCv: A PDF goes in a “CV” block.
placedInCell: {kind, select, video {Video} other {Image}} placed in cell {n}
freeGone: This free board no longer exists: reload the editor.
posterIsImage: A video's poster is an image.
freeImageRemoved: Image removed from the free board
singleBlockNoDuplicate: This block exists only once on the page: you can move and style it, but not duplicate it.
noNeighbourAccepts: No neighbouring block accepts this block.
deletedLost: Block deleted · Image changes in {count, plural, one {this project} other {these projects}} won't be published
deletedUndo: Block deleted · Undo (Ctrl+Z) to get it back
blockNotAcceptType: This block doesn't accept this type of block (or it is full).
fieldAdded: Field added · double-click its label to rename it
formKeepsField: A form keeps at least one field.
replyFieldKept: This email field is used to reply to you: in the panel, turn off “Used to reply to you” (or choose another field) before removing it.
fontDownloadFailed: Couldn't download “{family}” (connection lost). The font isn't applied.
projectCreated: Project “{title}” created: it goes public with the page
gridNoMore: This grid no longer accepts blocks.
expectAny: This block expects an image or a video.
dropOnProject: Drop the image on a project: between two images, or on an empty spot.
carouselAddedProject: “Scrolling images” goes in a “Project” block: I added one here. Choose its project, then click “Scrolling images” again.
carouselAddedBelow: “Scrolling images” added below the selected block
carouselSeveral: “Scrolling images” goes in a project. There are several on this page: click the “Project” block you want, then “Scrolling images”.
carouselNone: “Scrolling images” goes in a project. First add a “Project” block to the page and choose its project, then come back here.
itemGone: This block is no longer on the project: reload the editor.
shownAsStrip: Shown as “Scrolling images”: your images, captions and frames are kept
shownAsGrid: Shown as a grid: your images, captions and frames are kept
draftNotSaved: The draft isn't saved: try again.
publishImpossible: Publishing isn't possible: the list of points to fix is at the top of the page.
publishedSite: Published: the page is live, and the header and footer are up to date on all pages
addToMenuFailed: Couldn't add the page to the menu.
siteReverted: The site changes are cancelled: the live site is restored
copyFailed: Couldn't copy: open “See my current texts”.
hintTouch: Tap a block to add it below the selected block.
hintDrag: Drag it onto the page where you want it. Or click to add it below the selected block.
carouselDesc: A carousel of images and videos from your media library, in a “Project” block.
libraryEmpty: Your media library is empty: drop files above.
mediaTitle: {name}: click to place it, drag it onto a project
mediaHint: Click a thumbnail to place it in the selected image, video or grid (the little magnifier enlarges it without placing it), or drag it onto a project on the page: between two images, or onto an empty spot. You can also drop files from your computer straight onto the project.
pageEmpty: The page is empty. Add a first block from “Add”.
underlineHelp: The line under the current page's link and on hover. With no setting: the site's line color, otherwise the theme's.
onlyOnce: This block exists only once on the page.
inlineHint: Texts can also be edited directly on the page: double-click (or double-tap) them.
noSettingsInline: This block has no separate settings: its texts are edited directly on the page (double-click or double-tap them). Its layout is set below.
noSettings: This block has no separate settings: it is shown as is. Its layout (spacing) is set below; you can also move, duplicate or delete it with the buttons above.
clickBlock: Click a block on the page to adjust it. Texts are edited directly on the page.
pageSettingsHint: Page title, addresses and search-engine settings: <link>page form</link>.
strokeAllHelp: The theme's drawn line: scrollbar of the scrolling images, rules, menu underline. A color and an opacity blend with the original drawing. Each row of images and the header can have their own.
publishTitleNotLive: Puts the content and the page online
publishImpossibleCount: Publishing isn't possible: {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} to fix.
problemsHint: Click a line to go to the right place on the page.
warnHead: It's published. {many, select, true {A few points to look at} other {One thing to look at}}, nothing is blocking:
warnNotInMenu: This page is online but doesn't appear in any menu: visitors won't find it.
warnMissingAlt: {count, plural, one {# image} other {# images}} without a description (for visually impaired people and Google):
warnUntranslated: {label}. English-speaking visitors will see these passages empty or in French: fill in the “EN” fields in the editor.
conflictBody: (another tab, the form or a publication; the same applies to site changes, shared by all pages). Your latest changes aren't saved: nothing was overwritten.
corruptTitle: This draft can no longer be read
corruptBody: (a block has changed). The canvas shows what is left of it; nothing will be saved or published until you choose.
startFromPublished: Start again from the published version
siteChipBody: (name, menu, footer or social links): when this page is published, it changes on all pages.
foreignPage: The canvas is showing another page.
zoomNote: Large screen: {width} px wide, shown at {percent}%
deleteWithBlocks: Delete with its {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}
deleteRemoved: {count, plural, one {# block will be removed} other {# blocks will be removed}} with it.
deleteImagesLost: Image changes {count, plural, one {in its project} other {in its projects}} won't be published (the online images don't change).
deleteNote: It disappears from the draft; “Undo” (Ctrl+Z) gets it back. The site only changes when you publish.
whereEnd: At the end of the page
whereStart: At the top of the page
askLiveNote: It will be visible to everyone. You can take it off the site at any time, from the list of pages.
discardSiteNote: The name, menu, footer, social links, styles and logo go back to what is online, on all pages. Page changes are not affected. This action can't be undone.
resetTitle: Start again from the published version?
resetNote: The unreadable draft is erased; the online page doesn't change.
discardNote: The draft is erased and the page goes back to its online version. This action can't be undone.
canvasBlocks: {count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}} on the canvas
inMenuNow: The page is now in the menu
revealFirstBlock: The first block on the page appears right away: reveal does not play there.
revealNormalBlock: The block appears when scrolled into view. Visible in Preview; disabled if the visitor reduces motion.
copyImpossible: Copy impossible: the browser clipboard is unavailable or full.
blockCopied: Block copied: paste it here or on another page.
styleCopied: Style copied: paste it onto another block.
nothingToPaste: Nothing to paste: copy a block first.
targetGone: The target block no longer exists: choose another spot.
blocksPasted: {count, plural, one {# block pasted · Undo (Ctrl+Z) to remove it} other {# blocks pasted · Undo (Ctrl+Z) to remove them}}
noStyleToPaste: No style to paste: copy a block's style first.
stylePasted: Style pasted · Undo (Ctrl+Z) to revert it
